author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: The switch now updates as soon as the camera confirms On or Off. New lightMode and healthStatus attributes. An offline camera is logged once, with an hourly reminder and a recovery line. Debug logging now turns itself off after 30 minutes, and a new descriptionText logging option (on by default) logs value changes. After updating, click Initialize on the device. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
